key.name: device-enabled
key.summary: Lights on or off, per hub device
key.description: Maps a device id ('OMEN-PC', 'IQUNIX-KEYBOARD') to on/off. Missing means on.

key.name: device-brightness
key.summary: Light brightness per hub device, percent
key.description: Maps a device id to 0..100. Missing means 100.

key.name: device-modes
key.summary: Lighting effect per device
key.description: Maps a device name to an effect name, e.g. {'HP Omen 30L': 'Static'}.

key.name: zone-colours
key.summary: Colour per light zone

key.name: device-speeds
key.summary: Effect speed per device, percent
key.description: Maps a device name to 0 (slowest) .. 100 (fastest). Only moving effects use it.

key.name: device-min-brightness
key.summary: Dimmest point of a pulsing effect per device, percent

key.name: device-max-brightness
key.summary: Brightest point of a pulsing effect per device, percent

key.name: lcd-enabled
key.summary: Cooler LCD on or off (off shows a black screen)

key.name: lcd-brightness
key.summary: Cooler LCD brightness, percent

key.name: lcd-image
key.summary: Image shown on the cooler LCD
key.description: Absolute path. Empty leaves the built-in OMEN logo.

key.name: lcd-fit
key.summary: fill crops the image to cover the screen; fit shows all of it with black bars

key.name: lcd-recent-images
key.summary: Recently used LCD images, newest first, at most 8

key.name: auto-devices
key.summary: Auto mode per hub device: match it to the app in use
key.description: Maps a device id to on/off. Missing means off.

key.name: auto-lights
key.summary: In auto mode, colour the lights from the focused app's icon

key.name: auto-lcd
key.summary: In auto mode, show the focused app's icon on the LCD

key.name: auto-idle-image
key.summary: In auto mode, the picture shown when nothing is in focus
key.description: Absolute path. Empty uses the operating system's logo.

key.name: auto-idle-colour
key.summary: In auto mode, the light colour when nothing is in focus
key.description: '#RRGGBB'. Empty takes the colour from the idle picture.

key.name: focused-app
key.summary: Written by the extension: the app that has focus
key.description: An app id such as 'firefox.desktop', or empty when nothing has focus. Only kept up to date while auto mode is on.

key.name: default-look
key.summary: The Default look, shown on every device when the hub stops
key.description: JSON: a copy of the look settings (see core/settings_schema.py DEFAULT_KEYS).

key.name: default-action
key.summary: Written by the extension: 'save' makes the current look the Default, 'load' the other way round

key.name: status
key.summary: Written by the hub only
key.description: JSON: {"auto": {"app": str, "colour": str}, "has-default": bool, "devices": [{"id": str, "label": str, "connected": bool, "lights": [{"name": str, "modes": [str], "zones": [str], ...}], ...}]}. OMEN-PC adds "lcd", "case", "ram" (bool) and "error" (str).
